sentences.text: This Crl.M.C. has been filed challenging Annexure-A3 order in Crl.M.P.No.4507 of 2023 in C.P.No.52 of 2023 arising out Crime No.940 of 2022 of Mathilakam Police Station, Thrissur.
The petitioner faces prosecution under Sections 342, 354A(1)(i), 376 and 376(2)(n) and 506 of the Indian Penal Code.
2. The petitioner was granted bail through Annexure-A2 order by the Judicial First Class Magistrate Court, Kodungallur.

entities.text: Judicial First Class Magistrate Court, Kodungallur
entities.label: COURT

sentences.text: One of the conditions upon which bail was granted, was that the petitioner shall not leave the State without prior permission of the trial court.

The learned Magistrate rejected the application filed by the petitioner for release of the passport through Annexure-A3 order dated 06.07.2023, since the offence is exclusively triable by the Court of Session and considering the conditions imposed in the order granting bail, the Committal Court is not in a position to consider the application for release of the passport.
3. Having heard the learned counsel for the petitioner and the learned Public Prosecutor, I am of the view that having regard to the fact the bail was granted by the very same Court where committal proceedings are now pending, it will be open to the petitioner to file applications for modification of the condition No.4 imposed while granting bail through Annexure-A2 order and thereafter seek for release of the passport.
If these applications are filed by the petitioner, both these applications shall be considered on merits by the Judicial First Class Magistrate Court, Kodungallur.

entities.text: Judicial First Class Magistrate Court, Kodungallur
entities.label: COURT

sentences.text: This Crl.M.C. is disposed of as above.
